items.title: Mercedes F1's drivers still get the final say, even as it utilizes AI agents
items.summary: Toto Wolff, Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team Principal and CEO and Judson Althoff, Microsoft (MSFT) Commercial Business CEO, join Yahoo Finance's Deirdre Bosa to discuss the scale of AI and compute behind the Mercedes F1 team, including more than 10 million race-day simulations and millisecond-level collaboration between remote analysts, the pit garage, and the driver.

items.title: Could a handful of tech giants control the future of AI?
items.summary: In the Loop host Ejaaz Ahamadeen examines the growing concentration of power in artificial intelligence and why the industry's future could be shaped by just a handful of tech giants. He explores what the dominance of major AI players could mean for competition, innovation, and the companies racing to lead the next wave of AI development.

items.title: Can Microsoft catch up in the frontier AI race?
items.summary: "In The Loop" host Ejaaz Ahamadeen sits down with Deirdre Bosa to share his thoughts on Microsoft's (MSFT) place among AI frontier models.

items.title: Has AI's honeymoon ended on Wall Street?
items.summary: Although the AI industry has been the darling of Wall Street for years, the sector now makes investors wince as it reckons with a wave of concerns over dizzying spending and its promise to make the technology profitable.But as spending has ballooned, so has debt -- and profits have yet to match.

items.title: How to Survive the Coming Age of Everything Breaking
items.summary: We wanted a hyperconnected world and now we have to live in it.

items.title: CrowdStrike, Zscaler Merger Would Create Cybersecurity Giant
items.summary: CrowdStrike stock fell and Zscaler stock popped amid a report the companies are in merger talks. A deal would create a cybersecurity giant.

items.title: Mets Owner Steve Cohen’s Fund Dumped Nearly All of Its AMD and Bet $1 Billion That Microsoft Is the Safer AI Stock. AMD Has Fallen 31% Since
items.summary: Steve Cohen's Point72 sold 99% of its AMD shares in the third quarter and raised its Microsoft stake from 31,522 shares to 2,055,578, about $1 billion of buying, its Nov. 16 13F shows. AMD has fallen 31% since Sept. 30 and Microsoft 6%. The same filing tripled Intel, which has since lost more than half its value.

items.title: Nvidia Can Rebound to $200, Analyst Says. Plus, L3Harris and 4 More Stocks.
items.summary: Analysts report on Nvidia, L3Harris, Viking Holdings, Dolby Laboratories, Microsoft, Nvidia, and Lowe’s.
